description: Fetch a URL's content into the knowledge base. Server crawls the URL, stores the response body in R2, returns the new document ID. Failures store the row with status='failed'. Use for adding marketing pages, FAQ docs, or external references the agent should be aware of.

url.description: URL to fetch (must be https / http and publicly reachable)

name: scrape_knowledge_url

data.description: Tool result payload — shape varies per tool, see the tool description

renderType.description: UI rendering hint for the result

summary.description: One-line human-readable summary of the action
